claims.statement: Tom Allen failed to appear at Parson Davies' place in Chicago on December 11, 1882, to put up preliminary forfeit for a championship prize fight with James Elliott.
claims.excerpt: place, Chicago, to put up preliminary forfeit

fights.excerpt: place, Chicago, to put up preliminary forfeit
fights.notes: Forfeit by Allen: he failed to appear to put up the preliminary forfeit; Elliott and his backer were on hand.
